name: half-built-app-hospital
description: Describe an unfinished app and get a provisional, evidence-linked recovery plan.

paragraphs: Describe an unfinished app and get a provisional, evidence-linked recovery plan: up to three clarifying questions, a diagnosis that separates reported facts from hypotheses, and an editable recovery board you check off yourself. It reads text only. It does not scan, run, or certify anything.
Three fictional patients work with no sign-in and no AI calls. Live assessments are off by default and gated by a human check, per-IP and per-session limits, and global budgets.

Status: a personal portfolio project. The sample experience is complete. Live mode is built and tested but switched off until the deployment checks and the final legal text are done. The terms and privacy pages are drafts with placeholders, not reviewed by a lawyer.
